title: Client interop lattice and auth+streaming triage for enterprise SDK requests
creator: Ava Thompson
description: Synthesize incoming enterprise requests for SDK and client library work into a prioritized "interop lattice" that maps language bindings -> auth patterns -> streaming ergonomics. Goal: produce a deterministic intake outcome (Accept / Defer / Requires-Enterprise-PoC) with clear acceptance criteria and a deliverable list for engineering. This ticket captures the triage rubric, example signals, and immediate next steps to prototype the top three enterprise lanes.
acceptance_criteria: Triage rubric documented and reviewed by PM + Security + DX
Top-3 language/auth/streaming lanes identified with concrete implementation notes
Prototype scope for each lane defined (minimal bindings + auth flow + smoke tests)
Telemetry events and product hooks specified so adoption can be measured
Pass security checklist for enterprise auth patterns (token rotation, KMS integration, SSO guidance)
decision_notes: We will prioritize lanes by a composite score: customer_snr (signal-to-noise), security_risk, dev_effort, and telemetry_coverage.
Favor building language shims (thin adapters) over full separate SDKs when runtime surface area is identical; reduces maintenance burden.
Streaming ergonomics will adopt a single canonical pattern (event-stream + reconnect semantics + resume token) with per-language ergonomic wrappers. This avoids drifting semantics across bindings.
For auth, canonical flows to support initially: API key rotation guidance, OAuth2 service-account flow, and SAML/SSO high-level docs; mTLS as follow-up if customer demand warrants.

field_signals_summary: 18 enterprise inbound asks since 2025-09; strongest requests for Node (9 requests) and Python (5 requests). Key asks: token rotation, resumable streams, and clearer SSO guidance. Direct customer quotes in attachments.
risk_mitigation: Do minimum surface exposure for new auth flows: surface patterns as examples in repo (not recommended libs). Ensure security signoff before any published example that handles credential exchange. Start with thin adapter approach to reduce blast radius.
next_steps: 1) Review rubric with Eng + Security + DX by 2026-03-19; 2) Kickoff Node prototype (owner: Rajat) 2026-03-22; 3) Align telemetry events with Observability team and add dashboard template
notes_for_engineering: Expect to reuse existing HTTP streaming infrastructure. Key engineering tasks: implement resume token validation in runtime, expose reconnect hooks in SDK, add server-side metrics for resume-success. Prototype can be feature-flagged behind enterprise tenants.
estimated_cost_notes: Rough estimate: 6-8 sprints of combined effort if we fully implement three language lanes; initial prototype scope targets 2 sprints for Node + telemetry hooks.
